subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should #38327 remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack dependency path be split into a separate canonical issue now?
rationale: The active PR covers only the sanitizer slice, while the remaining dependency/auth-stack path touches provider auth and dependency policy where automation should not choose the long-term ownership or close shape alone.

options.title: Keep #38327 canonical
options.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof or repair.

options.title: Split ADC/gaxios now
options.body: Move the service-account ADC dependency failure into a focused canonical follow-up and close #38327 only after sanitizer verification.

options.title: Override sanitizer proof only
options.body: A provider owner may accept source-level sanitizer proof, but the ADC reproduction still needs a durable open tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep #38327 canonical
recommendation.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof or repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and close/split triage for the canonical issue.
